title: Spanish Paella-Style Japanese Serrano Ham
description: A fusion dish combining Japanese flavors with Spanish paella-style cooking. Serrano ham is marinated in a sweet soy sauce and sake mixture before being grilled to perfection.

ingredients.name: juicy
ingredients.amount: 2 cups, mixed Japanese vegetables (e.g. bell peppers, zucchini, carrots)

instructions: 2. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sake, brown sugar, rice vinegar, and sesame oil. Add sliced serrano ham and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
3. Cook Japanese rice according to package instructions.
4. Grill marinated serrano ham for 2-3 minutes per side, or until caramelized.
5. Grill mixed Japanese vegetables for 3-4 minutes per side, or until tender.
6. To assemble paella, layer cooked rice, grilled vegetables, and grilled serrano ham in a large skillet or paella pan.
7. Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
